definitions.true_scores: Reviewed visible frames only; animation phases are included. Repeated frames from same game are correlated, not independent samples.
definitions.hard_negatives: Reviewed 86 top-30 mined NON-DEFEAT neighborhoods (including VICTORY) plus 74 reviewed NEGATIVE and VICTORY windows. Mining at 1 FPS is not full-frame false-positive guarantee.
definitions.event_supported: At least 2 distinct native PTS with span >=1/120s in same class within .5s; this measures local consolidation availability, not whole-video sampling recall.
